about.title: About Me

about.personalLine: I've spent seven years on the unglamorous part of the stack: APIs, data models, tests, and getting code out the door without drama.
content: Senior Software Engineer based in Preston, UK. I specialise in PHP, Python, and Node.js backends, with full-stack delivery in React, Next.js, and React Native. I've led teams across Singapore, the US, and the UK — from microservices and TDD to hiring and code reviews.

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.subtitle: A track record of impactful roles, technical leadership, and shipping production-ready code.

items.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
items.company: ASquared | B Corp™ | Digital Product Agency
responsibilities: Architect and deliver full-stack solutions using React/Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/Supabase, and React Native (Expo) for cross-platform web and mobile applications.
Design scalable backend architectures, APIs, and data models with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and performance.
Develop mobile applications using React Native for tablet and mobile devices, with emphasis on usability, performance, and production readiness.
Build secure authentication systems, role-based access controls, and production-grade REST APIs.
Establish engineering standards including Git workflows, testing strategies, code quality practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
Containerise applications with Docker and manage cloud deployments using modern DevOps practices.
Collaborate directly with clients and stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs, roadmaps, and deliverables.

items.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer (Contract)
responsibilities: Built and maintained Docker environments across multiple repositories, enabling consistent local development and production parity.
Achieved 100% test coverage using pytest, covering edge cases, integration flows, and ensuring stability of AI pipelines.
Authored clean, concise technical documentation for setup, testing, and deployment to enhance team collaboration and onboarding.
Tested AI agents in Cursor, evaluating code suggestions for correctness, usability, and explanation quality.

items.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Led end-to-end delivery across multiple projects, owning architecture decisions, timelines, and code quality while mentoring developers.
Designed and implemented microservice architectures using Python, PHP, Vue, React, and TypeScript.
Upgraded dependencies across major frameworks (Next.js, React, Drupal, Vue) to ensure long-term maintainability, security, and compatibility.
Reduced deployment time from 1 hour to 5 minutes by implementing CI/CD pipelines.
Managed AWS infrastructure deploying applications on EC2, configuring RDS, using S3 for storage, and leveraging CodeCommit for production deployments.
Played an active role in hiring by conducting interviews, reviewing technical assessments, and evaluating candidates.

items.title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Led backend development with a focus on PHP, Python, and MySQL, ensuring high scalability and performance.
Reduced API response time from 10s to 500ms by optimising SQL queries and implementing caching with Redis and Elasticsearch.
Led the shift from monolithic to microservices architecture using Docker, boosting performance and efficiency.
Developed RESTful APIs and integrated third-party services for diverse client requirements.
Conducted technical training sessions for junior developers and participated in hiring and technical interviews.

items.title: Full Stack Developer
responsibilities: Contributed to both backend and frontend development using PHP, JavaScript, and SQL, delivering user-friendly applications in a fast-paced environment.
Implemented robust, data-driven solutions to enhance user interaction and streamline content management systems.
Worked closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver efficient, scalable web applications.

items.title: Joey AI

outcome.problem: Clinicians needed structured pre-consultation data from parents.
outcome.result: Built LLM workflows with safety guardrails that turn parent conversations into clinical summaries.

description: Developed an AI assistant that engages parents in structured conversations to collect symptoms and developmental information prior to clinical consultations.
Built conversational workflows using LLMs and prompt engineering to guide symptom collection and adaptive questioning.
Implemented safety guardrails and model armor policies to ensure safe, reliable interactions.
Generated structured clinical summaries from parent conversations for review by healthcare professionals.

items.title: LLM-Powered Research Assistant

outcome.problem: Researchers needed intelligent search across academic papers.
outcome.result: Delivered vector-search assistant with LangChain, Qdrant, Ollama, and Elasticsearch.

description: Created a vector-search-based academic assistant using LangChain, Ollama, Qdrant, and Elasticsearch, allowing users to query papers intelligently.
Used Python for ingestion pipeline and API development, orchestrated AI tasks using LangChain.

items.title: ReelLife Conversations

outcome.problem: Dementia care teams needed a tablet-first tool for structured conversations.
outcome.result: Shipped React Native (Expo) monorepo with shared web, mobile, and FastAPI backend.

description: Led development of a tablet-first application for dementia care, delivering a cross-platform mobile solution using React Native (Expo).
Architected a monorepo containing mobile, web, and backend services with shared components and workflows.
Built scalable backend services in TypeScript, designing APIs, authentication, and data models for secure multi-client use.
Delivered production-ready system end-to-end, from concept and architecture to deployment.

items.title: AQUA Expeditions

outcome.problem: Luxury cruise bookings required reliable backend under production load.

description: Developed backend using PHP, Python, and TypeScript, ensuring seamless functionality for the luxury cruise booking platform.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Docker to ensure continuous integration and testing.
